name: Consecration
overview: Consecration in Scripture involves dedicating people, places, and offerings to the Lord as an act of faith and obedience. Abel’s offering of the firstlings of his flock was accepted by God, demonstrating the importance of giving the best to Him. Abraham’s preparation of the altar to offer Isaac shows the solemn commitment involved in consecration. Personal vows, such as those by Jacob and Jephthah, highlight the conditional and intentional nature of consecration, where individuals commit themselves or others to God’s service in response to His promises or deliverance.
